scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix shortlink && npm ci --prefix ecommerce && npm ci --prefix ecommerce-ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix shortlink && npm run typecheck --prefix ecommerce && npm run typecheck --prefix ecommerce-ui
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm test --prefix shortlink && npm test --prefix ecommerce && npm test --prefix ecommerce-ui
scripts.dev: sh -c 'trap "kill 0" INT TERM; npm run dev:api & npm run dev:ui & wait'
